economic_thesis: Persistent common crypto moves provide a causal bull/bear directional forecast, while residual medium/slow strength, short reversal, and past funding carry provide a distinct two-sided relative opportunity whose blend adapts to fast/slow trend agreement.

expected_regime_roles.bear: Aligned negative common trend increases short gross, and the relative sleeve shorts persistent residual weakness while retaining active longs.
expected_regime_roles.bull: Aligned positive common trend increases long gross, and the relative sleeve owns persistent residual strength while retaining active shorts.
expected_regime_roles.chop: Fast/slow disagreement reduces net exposure and shifts the relative blend toward three-bar residual reversal and funding carry.
expected_regime_roles.long_sleeve: Owns the highest returned common-plus-relative forecasts and should carry bull plus relative-recovery attribution.
expected_regime_roles.short_sleeve: Shorts the lowest returned common-plus-relative forecasts and should carry bear plus relative-fade attribution.
expected_regime_roles.stress: Median aggregation, bounded transforms, broad sleeves, and a 0.04 coin cap limit outlier concentration; profitability remains an empirical gate.

falsifier: Reject if the exact no-control reference has nonpositive aggregate or doubled-cost return or Sharpe; nonpositive bull, bear, or chop return or Sharpe; failed long-bull, short-bear, or combined-chop attribution; fewer than four profitable folds; positive-quarter fraction below 0.55; incomplete A5 score coverage; nonpositive pooled score IC or fewer than four positive fold ICs; inactive sleeves; or positive-PnL concentration above 0.40. Controls, neighbors, and private data cannot rescue it.
mechanism: Every 48 hours, form a common crypto state from median 8-hour returns, 21/126-bar bounded trend, and 21-bar sign breadth. Blend 21/63-bar median-residual trend with three-bar residual reversal according to fast/slow trend agreement, add small past-funding carry, center-rank the relative forecast, add the common state, capture once at A5, and construct broad two-sided sleeves from only the returned scores.
risk_policy_plan: Run only the exact disabled no-control pivot reference first. No risk control, stop, neighbor, or private ticket is authorized unless that reference passes every broad alpha, regime, role, fold, quarter, sleeve, concentration, score-IC, and coverage gate. Controls cannot repair a failed mechanism.
selection_metric: Noncompensatory eligibility first: every no-control and score-evidence gate must pass. No controlled or neighboring result can substitute for the exact reference.
